messages:
jin: heads-up - I ran the KernelSelector autotune sweep on L4 / T4 / A10 and A100 / H100 yesterday. Found some cross-arch path divergence for seqlen 64->512. Dumping salient bits.

alex: thanks. any regressions? :eyes: 

jin: TL;DR: auto-pick favors small-block GEMM kernels on L4/T4 at seqlen<=128, but picks larger fused attention kernels on A100/H100. That yields ~1.8x token/s on small GPUs for short seq, but a 10-15% regression on long sequences when selector overfavors small-blocks due to our naive cost model.

maria: can you paste the cost formula you're using?

jin: current cost model: estimated_latency = kernel_base + per_token * seq_eff + mem_penalty*warm_kv_hits. simplified in code as:
```
cost = base_ms + seq_len * token_ms / batch_eff + (kv_miss ? kv_pen_ms : 0)
```
Not accounting for warp occupancy drop on L4 for fused kernels.

sam: perf-bot results?

perf-bot: autotune_sweep_195000.csv
L4 seqlen=64 batch=8 best=small_block_gemm (lat 12.3ms)
L4 seqlen=128 batch=4 best=small_block_gemm (lat 20.7ms)
L4 seqlen=256 batch=2 best=small_block_gemm (lat 48.1ms)
L4 seqlen=512 batch=1 best=small_block_gemm (lat 85.6ms)
A100 seqlen=64 batch=8 best=fused_attn_v2 (lat 7.1ms)
A100 seqlen=128 batch=4 best=fused_attn_v2 (lat 12.9ms)
A100 seqlen=256 batch=2 best=fused_attn_v2 (lat 21.6ms)
A100 seqlen=512 batch=1 best=fused_attn_v2 (lat 38.2ms)
Notes: seqlen scaling non-linear on L4: 64->128 good, 256->512 latency jumps. mem bandwidth saturation + cache thrash suspected.

alex: hmm so selector chooses small_block for A10 too?

jin: yes for A10 it's similar to T4. On A10 fused kernel suffers mem thrash due to limited shared mem per SM; KV cache eviction increases. Observed extra memcpy overhead on batch churn.

maria: any quick fix? adjust cost model?

jin: propose two changes:
- add architecture_penalty factor tuned per GPU family (roughly 0.9 on h100, 1.1 on l4)
- add seqlen_curve term: favor fused when seq_len > seq_threshold[arch]
Also need to track kv_hit_rate in real time (we currently use static heuristics).

sam: risk of flips during rollouts?

jin: yes classifier flips cause request tail jitter. We'll add hysteresis: require 3 consecutive tuning decisions same before switching kernel, and expose per-route override. :thumbsup: 

alex: can we simulate production batching patterns rather than uniform batches?

maria: I ran synthetic mix with pareto seqlen distribution; tuning changed picks: L4 still small_block for <=128, fused for >=256 when batch_eff > 4. I'll drop the CSV in thread.

maria: upload link: /perf/artifacts/1950006789/autotune-mix.csv

jin: next steps: implement arch_penalty + seqlen_curve in KernelSelector, add kv_hit_rate telemetry (done in dev branch), run A/B on canary pool (10%) for 48h. I'll open PR.

sam: +1. also add a regression alert if p99 latency increases >7%.

jin: noted. I'll include rollout plan + rollback criteria in PR. If anyone wants to review the cost model diff ping me. Thanks all.
